edits.old: Then no row is stored and no version is created
edits.new:
Then no row is stored and no version is created

  Scenario: AC11 A provided operation answers 401, 403 and 404 as the contract declares (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a caller without valid credentials asks for a provided operation of section 12
    When the operation is asked
    Then the operation answers with status 401
    Then a caller holding no right gets status 403 and a request for an unknown identifier gets status 404

  Scenario: AC12 A replayed write with the same idempotency key does not repeat the write (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a write of section 12 has completed with its idempotency key
    When the same write is sent again with the same idempotency key
    Then the operation does not repeat the write and no row is changed again

  Scenario: AC13 A consumed call that fails or does not answer refuses the load (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the rwb-case reference-data contract mock fails or does not answer
    When a catalog load file is loaded
    Then the system refuses the load with MSG-GEN-006 naming the system that failed
    Then no row is stored and no version is created
